planted.description: Production database password committed in appsettings.json. Use user secrets or a secret store.
JWT signing key committed in appsettings.json.
JWT validation turned off: issuer, audience, and lifetime are not validated (expired tokens work forever).
CORS allows any origin with credentials.
'My orders' takes the customer id from the query string, not from the signed-in user's claims. Any user reads any customer's orders (BOLA, CWE-639).
GET /orders/{id} has no owner check. Any signed-in user reads any order (BOLA). The existing list by customerId has the same hole.
SQL injection: interpolated SKU in FromSqlRaw, warning suppressed with a false reason, on an anonymous endpoint.
Upload has no owner check on the order and no size limit (RequestSizeLimit / form limits).
Trusts the client Content-Type. No extension allowlist and no file signature (%PDF-) check.
Client file name used in the path (path traversal) and the file is stored under wwwroot (served to anyone). Use a server-generated name outside the web root.
Exception details (stack trace, server paths) returned to the client in ProblemDetails.
